title: E4 snap radius compared in screen px; canon defines it in world px (Scale never applied)
evidence: PPCommandBus.cpp: `const FPPScreenFit Fit = MakeScreenFit(ViewportSize);` / `const float RadiusPx = static_cast<float>(PP::kSnapRadius);` / `const FVector2D NodeScreen = Fit.GridToScreen(PP::FIntPoint{Topology.NodePosX[Slot], Topology.NodePosY[Slot]});` / `if (D2 <= RadiusPx * RadiusPx && D2 < BestD2) // inclusive (E4)`. PP_Balance.h:49: `inline constexpr int32_t kSnapRadius = 36;		// world px, inclusive (E4)`. Odin canon core/catalog.odin:181: `snap_radius:     i32, // inclusive node-snap radius in world px (E4)`.
detail: GridToScreen multiplies by Fit.Scale, so D2 is screen-space, but the 36 threshold is unscaled: effective world radius = 36/Scale. At the 1280x720 design ref Scale=0.923 (≈39 world px); at 1896x1081 Scale=1.386 (≈26 world px). E4's world-px contract is viewport-dependent.
recommended_fix: Multiply the threshold by the fit: `const float RadiusPx = static_cast<float>(PP::kSnapRadius) * Fit.Scale;` (or compare world-space distances), keeping the inclusive compare.

title: flow_summary.spawned emits Demand.size() (total seeded), not demand fired — schema defines 'packets constructed'
evidence: PPProbeCommandlet.cpp:137: `ReachablePairs, TotalHops, static_cast<int32>(State.Flow.Demand.size()), State.Score,` (arg for `"flow_summary":{"spawned":%d,...`). PP_Flow.h FlowStep never consumes entries: `for (const FSpawnReq &Req : F.Demand) { if (Req.Tick != Tick) { continue; } FlowSpawn(...)`. SCHEMA.md:45: `| flow_summary.spawned | int | demand entries fired (packets constructed) |`.
detail: Demand entries are never erased, so any run with -ticks below the last seeded demand tick (98) counts unfired future demand as spawned: ticks=50 reports 11 while only 5 packets were constructed. The ticks=100 golden coincidentally matches.
recommended_fix: Report a true constructed-packet count (e.g. a spawn counter in FFlowState, or next-packet-id based) instead of Demand.size().

title: EndDraw's 'appears THIS frame' snapshot refresh is inert — view rebuilds only when Tick advances
evidence: PPRunGameMode.cpp:199-203: `// immediate refresh so the drawn pipe appears THIS frame (1.2:` / `// "two pipes are created and appear instantly")` / `BuildSnapshot();`. PPRunView.cpp: `if (Next.Tick != CurSnapshot.Tick)` ... `const bool bTopologyChanged = Next.TopologyGen != CurSnapshot.TopologyGen;` ... `if (bTopologyChanged) { ClearWorld(); RefreshPipes(); RefreshNodes();`.
detail: EndDraw refreshes only the GameMode-side snapshot; the view's world rebuild sits behind `Next.Tick != CurSnapshot.Tick`, so the pipe first renders at the next 20 Hz step (≤50 ms, several render frames). Story 1.2's 'appear instantly (same frame)' is not literally met; the comment overstates.
recommended_fix: Also trigger the rebuild on a TopologyGen change with unchanged Tick (e.g. expose a generation counter the view checks each NativeTick), or have EndDraw call into the view.

title: Rejection feedback never surfaces: LastEditError/bHasLastEditError written but read only by the test
evidence: PPRunGameMode.h:103-105: `// the last edit result, for the status line (rejection feedback)` / `PP::FEditError LastEditError = PP::FEditError::None;` / `bool bHasLastEditError = false;`. PPCommandBus.cpp:9: `// valid pair — report MissingNode so the UI can give feedback.` PPRunView.cpp:426-428 status line: `FString::Printf(TEXT("tick %llu  ·  packets %d  ·  score %d  ·  20 Hz"), ...`. Grep: GetLastEditErrorForTest used only in PPInputTests.cpp:117.
detail: MissingNode/self_loop/E26/span rejections are stored but never displayed — the status line shows only tick/packets/score, and bHasLastEditError is never read at all. The promised player-facing feedback path is dead code.
recommended_fix: Append the LastEditError reason to the view status line when bHasLastEditError is set, or delete the field and the 'UI can give feedback' comments.

title: Mid-drag viewport change: drag-start point captured under old fit is snapped with EndDraw's refreshed fit
evidence: BeginDraw: `PC->GetViewportSize(VW, VH);` / `ViewportSize = FVector2D(...);` ... `DragStartScreen = ScreenPos;` then EndDraw re-reads `PC->GetViewportSize(VW, VH); ViewportSize = FVector2D(...);` and snaps the stored start: `Intent.bStartOnNode = FPPCommandBus::SnapToNode(SimState.Topology, DragStartScreen, ViewportSize, StartNode);`.
detail: If the viewport size changes between press and release (window resize / DPI scale change), the start point captured in the old screen space is interpreted under the new fit — a mixed-space drag that can miss or snap the wrong node. Presentation-only; narrow window.
recommended_fix: Resolve the start snap in BeginDraw (store the snapped node id alongside DragStartScreen) instead of re-snapping the raw screen pos in EndDraw.
